batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b YS Chahal

batting.name: SPD Smith
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b MA Starc

batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: c D Wiese b MA Starc

batting.name: JP Faulkner
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b HV Patel

batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b SR Watson

balls.text: on the stumps now, Tambe gets bat and pushes it down to mid on for one
just misses the bat, just misses off stump! Full delivery with some swing outside off, Tambe drove and missed it for the keeper
targets the yorker again, Morris comes down and mistimes the full toss in the air towards mid off for one
low full toss outside off, pushed just wide of cover point for one
full and outside off, he drives and misses the first ball
sheer pace and accuracy, Starc smiles as the off stump goes for a walk! Kulkarni made some room and the ball landed on length and rocketed onto the stumps to send it flying
slower ball outside off, mistimed completely as it's chipped just over point for one

this is a superb catch! What a wonderful piece of anticipation.. DK starts moving towards his left as soon as he sees Faulkner shaping for the scoop shot and once the batsman doesn't make a good connection, he is always in business. It still takes some doing as he has to dive full length to his left to complete this one-handed. Superb effort from DK
tails in towards the middle stump, the batsman scythes it towards wide long on
bowls the slower bouncer now, that is easily pulled away to deep midwicket for a single
hones this length delivery towards off stump, Morris aims to hit across the line and ends up pushing it towards long on
aims for the yorker but this low full toss is pushed towards Sarfaraz at extra cover for just a single
fuller and on the pads, Faulkner flicks it but cannot beat the long-haired Badri at square leg. Just a single there
makes some good connection on this but clearly it's not enough! Binny hits the fuller delivery inside out but can only sky it towards Wiese at deep extra cover. Starc takes out two. Hail the Avengers
back of length on off, Faulkner dabs it straight to point and takes off for a single. Gayle fumbles his pick up and allows an easy one
was there some reverse there? Possibly. That swungs away from leg stump towards middle. Binny closes the bat face and gets a thick outside edge to third man
full and fast again, Binny swings but can't put a bat on it

he has made a blow first up! Serves up one that is full and fast, Smith wants to smash it over long on but that's too quick. All he can manage is a thick top edge that swirls in the air towards gully. DK has plenty of time to move to his right and settle under this. This is going to hurt Royals even more
high in the air but it lands safe! Binny charged and lofted it high over cover with a leading edge, but neither cover nor deep cover could get there
looked like the googly from outside off, Smith came down and drove it into the covers
slightly slower and Binny reverse sweeps it to Gayle at short third man
that was headed straight for the stumps with some turn, but Binny went back and opened the face of the bat very late to defend on off
makes room and comes down, it's pitched wide outside off and he hammers it to deep cover for one
on the stumps, Binny unleashes the reverse sweep and easily clears point and short third man for four on the off side
that was way outside off, doesn't matter. Smith shuffles across completely and whips it with a pull over short fine leg for four
makes room, Wiese pitches it short with a slower ball and it's chipped over him for one to long off
that was going for a wide but Smith slapped it to sweeper cover for one
swings his bat outside off for the back of length ball and misses
in the air again, this time it lands in front of Starc at deep midwicket after Binny pulled it
dropped at long on by Abdulla! Binny came down and lofted that length delivery high in the air, would have been easy for the fielder but he put it down
angled in this time, Binny misses while trying to turn it to leg but gets a leg bye
clever shot for four! Back of length ball on off stump, Binny waited for it and helped it very late through the slip cordon for a cheeky four
bangs in the bouncer, Binny looks to hammer it with a pull but only gets a bottom edge back to the bowler
slower ball outside the off stump, pushed into the covers
straight and on off stump, punched down to long on for one
yorker right on middle and leg, Binny manages to get some bat on it and sneaks in a single
slightly slower and angling in, Binny steers it on the off side for one
charges down to swish at it on off, but gets another bottom edge to the keeper
touch back of length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover
angles it in again, but it's going towards leg and it's tucked behind square on leg for one
fuller and angling in, driven down to long on for one
offcutter pretty wide outside off, bottom edge goes to the keeper
waits for the the ball to come to him from leg stump, and he defends it back
reaches out for the length delivery and defends it back

another slog against the away-going delivery, another wicket! Looked like a pre-meditated shot as Samson went down on a knee and slog-swept the ball against the turn and missed the line completely. Off and middle stumps are rattled
slightly short of length and wider, it's punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for one
turn again as this was also on length from off, Samson pushed it back towards the bowler
turn for the length delivery from off stump, Samson leans forward and blocks it
touch wider outside off, driven down this time to long off for one
straightish just outside off with some turn, pushed back to the bowler who dives and stops
angles it in towards middle and leg stump, worked down to long on for one
slightly slow outside off, pushed tentatively just past short cover for one
wild slog for the straight delivery and that's gone through! The length delivery pitched on middle stump and turned away a bit as Hooda looked to slog it to the leg side and missed it by miles
pretty flat and wide outside off, called wide too
trots down and whips the ball from outside off to deep midwicket for one
slower and fuller outside off, driven to sweeper cover easily by Smith for one
back of length outside off, it's cut wide of point where Gayle gets a hand to it
he takes these risks and they all pay off! Shuffled across to expose all his stumps for the ball just outside off, and he whipped just past the leg stump to the boundary for four
gets the inside edge of the bat as he swishes at the ball outside off into the covers
touch back of length outside off, pushed straight to cover
slightly full outside off, driven uppishly from outside off but in the gap
fullish around off, flicked down the ground to long on for one

full toss gets a wicket, it's a run out, so what? Smith slashed at the high full toss that was well outside off, Harshal at sweeper cover came around as the batsmen looked for the second. It was a pretty flat throw, Kohli went to his right a bit, collected and threw the ball to the stumps, like Dhoni, to send Nair back
targets the off stump now, driven down to long off for one
almost in the block hole outside off, steers it late to third man for one
pretty full outside off, he can't clear cover
dropped by the bowler as Nair drove the full and straight ball back firmly to the umpire, Chahal tried to catch it with one hand but could not hold on to it
takes the pace off, 115kph, outside off and it's cut off the back foot to point
steers the back of length delivery from outside off wide of Kohli at cover point
back of length outside the off stump, punched off the back foot on off
even slower now - 117.5kph - and it's pushed down to long off for one
slightly slower at 129kph and full outside off, driven to sweeper cover for one
back of length and angling in towards off, guided to third man for one
flighted and full on off, driven down to long off for one
appeal for lbw as he tries the sweep again but it is struck just outside off
too full on middle and leg, and Nair take a big stride forward to sweep the ball well into the midwicket-boundary crowd for a six
a bit outside off, pushed off the back foot to long off
lofted down the ground but Mandeep at long off is too wide. It was slightly slower, Nair chipped it down and just checked his shot
length delivery on off, pushed into the covers off the front foot
short ball again, pulled to deep midwicket off the back foot for one
back of length outside off, Smith guides it to third man for one
short ball, Smith pulls it in the gap on leg just behind square but Chahal runs from deep midwicket to his right with a slide to save two
slightly slower ball around off, flicked to the leg side easily for one
pushes the ball from outside off to point
length delivery outside off is pushed into the covers with soft hands for a quick single. AB was the fielder but he fumbled to pick the ball up on first attempt. Gayle can't believe it
straighter one just outside off and Smith goes back to whip it to leg for one
comes down the track and drives the ball to long off for one

another shortish ball, another shot in the air and he's holed out to wide long-on! It was not a good delivery, but it looked like a trap as Watson went back to pull it but found Starc in the deep. The fielder didn't have to move at all
takes two quick steps down the ground to take the ball on the full and lofts it just over mid on to clear him and collect four
gets a bottom edge for the away-going delivery, as he tries to punch it back. Chahal gets a hand to it
welcomed with a six! Watson went back for the short of length delivery around off and smacked it over the long on boundary for a clean six
the slower delivery works, Rahane is gone! It was an offcutter coming in from outside off, Rahane moved across to help it to leg but could not connect and was trapped in front of middle stump
oh, that's a misfield at mid-off, goes for four! Rahane rolled his wrists a bit to drive the ball down, Sarfaraz slid to his right but couldn't stop the ball
bit slow around off stump, flicked to deep midwicket for one
punches the ball back to the bowler with a firm drive
short ball, Rahane pulls with an edge to mid on and sets off for a quick single
slightly slow around off, pushed down towards mid on
full on off again, flicked a bit wide of mid on for a quick single
bit of flight on middle stump and Rahane goes down to sweep it over square leg in the gap for four. He's playing the field now
fuller outside the off stump, driven straight to cover
on length outside off, pushed down to long off for one
full on off now, flicked off the front foot towards mid on for one
a bit too short and Rahane rocks back in the crease as if he knew it was coming, and lofts it over the long on fielder for a big six!
it's short again, but there's room on offer and Watson unleashes the upper cut to send it in the air over point for four
fullish on middle and leg now, flicked down to the leg side
length delivery on the off stump now, Watson blocks it back
short ball on leg stump now, Watson pulls it a bit awkwardly and manages to land it wide of midwicket and mid on for four
lands it in short outside off, angles it away and he lets it go
pretty full on off stump, driven straight down to mid-off
goes on the back foot and punches the ball down to long off to avoid a maiden
comes down the track and takes it on the full to drive it down to mid on, not from the middle though
pretty straight on middle and off, pushed back to the bowler
bit of flight outside off now, it didn't bounce much as Watson cut off the back foot
slightly slower on off stump, punched to cover off the back foot
length delivery outside off is pushed to cover
swing and a miss as Rahane drives away from his body for the ball that was moving away and beat him
thick edge in the air as it's pitched up, there was swing, and Watson pushed uppishly as it went to third man
too full from Starc outside off and Watson leans forward towards the ball to drive it handsomely through the covers for four
angles it across now from around off stump, without any swing, and Watto lets it go
tries the yorker and this one had the length right but line was too much on leg for a wide
fuller outside off now, pushed down towards mid-off for a quick single
bit too much this time as it swings down leg, past the pads, for a wide
appeal for lbw straightaway as Starc swings this one into Rahane, he came forward to flick it on leg and the ball would have most probably gone down leg. Maybe pitched outside leg too
full toss on the pads, flicked to the midwicket boundary for four to seal the game
good yorker on the leg stump, AB comes down and pushes the ball to long on
full around off, AB hardly moves and pushes it back to the bowler
full and wide, Kohli made room but got some bat to steer it to deep point
bangs it in short, Kohli comes down and slaps the ball along the ground wide of deep midwicket for two
swinging in a bit from off, Kohli punches it down to long on for one
short ball angling in, pulled to deep midwicket for one
comes down again, and yorks himself. Gets an inside edge to the leg side for one
tries to steer the ball to off but gets an inside edge back to the bowler
fuller outside off, driven with the turn to deep point for one
shorter delivery now and it's turned to the leg side for one
makes that another six! Kohli dances down the track, takes it on the full and slams it straight and over long on for six
full and flighted outside off, driven to cover and a fumble gives them one
pretty wide outside off, driven through the covers for one
slammed down the ground, four this time! He strolled down and took it nearly on the full, the bat also closed in his hands when he played the shot and he got enough to collect four down the ground
top edge from AB as he pulls the short ball to the leg side, doesn't get the middle and it falls short and wide of long on in the gap
just outside off, Kohli turns this one too to the leg side towards midwicket and brings up his fifty
length delivery and Kohli whips it away to the leg side in the gap for two
that's a straight drive while he was on the move for six! Kohli came down, Watson banged it in short outside off and Kohli replied with a lofted straight drive for a six into the sight screen
on the pads this time, whipped away, typical Kohli style, to deep square leg for one
fullish outside the off stump, driven to cover off the front foot
slower ball on middle stump, flicked straight to midwicket where there's a fumble
chipped in the air back towards Kohli, wide of Faulkner, as the ball bounced extra a little bit
outside the off stump, Kohli pushes this one towards sweeper cover for one
on middle and leg stump, clipped to the leg side around square for two
flighted with some turn outside off, driven down firmly to long off
charges down the pitch to take it on the full and slams it straight down the ground, long on cuts it off for two
Kohli cuts outside off and a thick edge goes to short third man
shorter outside off now, Kohli goes back and cuts it to point
slightly shorter on the off stump, punched off the back foot to deep cover for one
full and flighted on the stumps, whipped down to long on for one
closer to the off stump, Kohli opens the face of the bat to steer the ball to third man
outside off again, AB guides it fine this time past the keeper
run out chance missed! Kohli defended the slow back of length delivery towards the slips with soft hands and ran for it, AB responded but if Samson had hit the stumps Ab was out
tries the block hole, Kohli digs it out down to mid off
short ball angled in towards leg, AB pivots around a bit and keeps it down behind square on the leg side
length delivery outside off, pushed towards mid off for an easy one
fuller on the stumps, driven down to long on with a straight bat
slower offcutter towards middle and leg, clipped to deep midwicket for one
gets some room outside off, AB swishes at it to find the gap in the covers with some power for two
short ball towards the batsman, pulled late to fine leg for one more
back of length outside off now, AB guides it down to third man for one
angled into the pads, whipped away towards square leg for one
flight outside off, driven straight to cover by AB
errs down the leg side, AB stays back and clips it fine down the leg side for four easy runs
flighted, length delivery around off, driven down to long off for one
comes down the track and pushes the ball wide of cover point for one
bit too short and AB digs deep in the crease to pull it over midwicket and wide of deep midwicket for four in the gap
waits for the turn and punches the ball to cover
rolls his fingers over this one, AB punches the ball just wide of the stumps at non-striker's end to long on
cuts the back of length delivery back in, AB finds midwicket
bangs this one outside off, Kohli guides it to third man for one
bangs in the short ball, Kohli goes back and across to tuck the ball behind square. Tambe fumbles at deep fine leg and they come back immediately for the second
length delivery on the stumps now, pushed down to long on for one
strolls down and swishes at the ball by rolling the wrists to send the ball to deep point
right on the stumps on length, AB blocks it back
length delivery on the stumps, turned off the back foot to square leg for one
flighted and full on the pads, Kohli clips it square on the leg side and these two run two by the time anyone realises it
flatter and shorter, Kohli rocks back and hammers it over the midwicket boundary with a pull for a massive six!
full delivery outside off, driven into the covers for one
right on middle stump, Kohli goes back and pushes the ball to long on
another quick single - this time Kohli steers the ball towards point and by the time Rahane gets there, they have crossed each other and completed the run
that's very close, but no direct hit! AB tucked the ball late to short third man, Kohli is already halfway down the pitch and they sneak in a single that never existed!
gets room again, it's back of length this time and AB goes to the back foot to punch it through the covers with some power. Four more
comes down a couple of steps and pushes the ball down to mid off
doesn't take too long when he's on strike! Got width outside off and crashed it with a square drive just wide of backward point for four
slightly slow at 121kph from the leg side, Ab clips it off the pads on the leg side and races back for the second
slow and full outside off, Ab drives firmly and Smith stops it in the covers with a dive
nearly gets an inside edge onto the stumps! He cut the back of length ball from outside off, and the ball hit his pads after the edge
short of length and angled in, tucked off the back foot to short fine leg

such a slow delivery, such a big wicket! This was a slow-slow bouncer at 98kph, Gayle kept waiting and finally decided to pull, got a top edge as he just checked his shot, and Samson jumped to his right to take it with both hands over his head
slower ball outside off, punched down to mid off without any footwork
length delivery angled across off stump, pushed to cover point by Gayle
closer to the off stump from just back of length, Kohli guides it fine to third man where Morris slides to his left and saves two
too short this time, outside off, and Kohli spots it early to pull it over midwicket by getting under it. Four runs
charges down and defends the ball to cover, can't clear the fielder
short of length outside off, punched down along the ground to long on
touch wider outside off on the same length, Kohli guides it to third man and gives strike to Gayle
back of length on off stump, Kohli defends it on off
too short earlier, too full this time! It's in Gayle's zone as he lofts it straight down and over the mid-on boundary for six
short ball with width again, Gayle sees that's enough and slaps the ball over the covers in the air for another powerful four
high full toss towards the waist, pushed down to mid on
crashed through the covers! Back of length, room, Gayle stayed back and packed a crunching punch to send that crashing through the covers for four
squares him up a little bit as the slower ball goes towards off, Gayle defends it towards point
back of length outside off, Kohli leans towards the ball and guides it towards third man
slower one outside the off stump, Gayle waits and cuts it to cover point
straighter on middle stump, pushed down to mid on this time
mid off is not at the edge of the circle, Gayle gets a short of length ball outside off and he lofts it well over mid off for a well-executed four
swings this one down the leg side and Gayle doesn't get any bat again but deflects it off his pads, it goes fine down leg for four leg byes
back of length outside off, Kohli cuts but finds an inside edge to leg for one
touch back of length towards middle, flicked straight to midwicket
in the air but safe! It was outside off, Kohli pushed at it almost with a closed face of the bat and it flew just wide of cover
what an accurate yorker from Morris! Swung it in towards the toes, Gayle got the toe of his bat on it by moving his feet out of the way
swings and misses! Pitched up outside off, Gayle swings his arms and the ball beats him
widish outside off, Kohli drives it firmly by rolling the wrists to sweeper cover for one
errs down the leg side now, deflects off the pad for a leg bye
absolutely accurate inswinger towards off stump from Morris, Gayle gets his bat down on time to defend it back
